# Source and local adaptations

Source: [jakubkrehel/make-interfaces-feel-better](https://github.com/jakubkrehel/make-interfaces-feel-better/tree/35545ea1512ad59fa463e6b1f95ca9c052981fe6/skills/make-interfaces-feel-better).
Pinned commit: `35545ea1512ad59fa463e6b1f95ca9c052981fe6`. License: [LICENSE](LICENSE).

This is a repository-local, documentation-only adaptation. The entrypoint and
invocation metadata are Echo-owned; the selected references retain upstream text
with an Echo boundary notice. Links to omitted references point to the same
pinned upstream source; they are optional, not instructions to install or fetch
additional packages. No scripts, installers, CI definitions or product dependencies
are included. The original package was downloaded into a temporary directory for
inspection, not executed or installed into a developer's personal settings.

`SHA256SUMS` records the local reviewed bytes, including the entrypoint and metadata.
Hashes identify this snapshot; they are not a signature or runtime safety guarantee.
For an update, review changed instructions/examples, retain attribution, update the
pin and local hashes, then repeat configuration and role-catalog validation.
